1169347228127963035:
She returned to the point of departure.
She knew the shadow of Destruction had never truly left, just as the bliss in Planarcadia was only a result of postponed calamity.

She witnessed the return of the Herald of Death, her homeland lacerated in the maw of the beast.
She uncovered the root of the curse, trembling as she accepted the truth of her family's tragedy.
But this was an entirely unprecedented apocalypse. It made her face the possibility of losing her companions, Trailblazer most of all. She couldn't understand why the fate of the cosmos had to rest on {M#his}{F#her} shoulders. All she knew was that {M#he}{F#she} was now family, forever.
So, once again, she chose to carry it all alone, just as she always used to say:
"Traveling always has an end point. When it happens, I'll smile and say goodbye to everyone."

Amidst the mockery of the world falling into utter silence, the Starblazer reached its limit, and the Express crashed once more.
Before the farewell, she embraced Trailblazer and made a wish to the Stellaron to guard the Trailblaze.
The stars grew hazy in a crimson mist, and she became as weak as she once was.

"It's been so long. You've grown up... and become even more remarkable than I ever was."
For a fleeting moment, she thought she could feel the girl's warmth again as if she were still there, watching over her in silence.
"I think I've finally gotten a little closer to you."
She couldn't help but pour out everything that had happened since they parted: The paths walked by the legendary Navigators, now trodden by her own feet; the wonders she had once only dreamed of, witnessed with her own eyes; the companions she had found, those kindred spirits, people she could truly trust...
"Just as you once traded your destiny for mine, I would trade my destiny for my companions'..."
"But look, your companions aren't about to let you go anywhere."

Trailblazer's wish moved her to tears.
The unyielding defiance of the Nameless set her blood ablaze once more.
"Where your journey ends, mine begins anew..."
Two warm hands withdrew gently from her back, and the girl smiled with quiet tenderness, their silhouette slowly merging with each other.
"If there's nothing ahead of us..."
She became one with the ideal she had always strived toward, as her companions reached out their hands and cried out together,
"Then we'll Trailblaze a path forward with our own hands!"

124174536499018237:
His Trailblaze often begins with exploration and understanding.

"Little Dannie, hold on tight, sit tight, here we go..."
He sought knowledge of lost history from the red-haired girl, and they invited him to a history lesson overlooking the world.

"Kremnos's tradition?"
"Yes. May we have a duel?"
He asked the golden-haired crown prince. By the side, a white-haired youth was eager to try.
"I want to join as well. Traditions like this are better experienced."
The proud lion of Kremnos kept silent, responding only with a stance.

...

He ventured to the Grove, poring over every book in its collection, as the shattered world gradually took shape in his mind.
To find a way back to the stars, he delved deep into the ruins, investigating the mysteries of the world beyond the sky.

He records everything he experiences, just as he has done at every stop along the way.
But when the fate of the world rests upon a hero's shoulders, he knows that this "Trailblaze" cannot be reduced to mere cold entries.

Those were pivotal battles, each and every one.
Together with companions, they ended the history of "Strife" and witnessed the crown prince of Kremnos break from tradition.
Trailblazer joined the fray, returning the Coreflame of Time. When {F#she}{M#he} returned from the treacherous nether realm, he still couldn't forget the joy of that day, like one who had survived a catastrophe.

Those were also countless moments of farewell.
The Holy Maiden's thousand forms withered, the sage was reduced to ashes, and the daughter of the River of Souls bid her final farewell to the mortal realm... He remembered at the time of parting, they were either sorrowful or content, but never once did they show any regret.

"If one day, we too shall come to this..."
Thinking of Trailblazer's destiny and March 7th who had yet to arrive, he too had spent sleepless nights over this.

"For a thousand years, we have all been prepared to face sacrifice, or to sacrifice ourselves for our companions..."
He had seen it more than once... The weaver gathering relics, embroidering them with a golden flower.
"Now... there are no regrets left."

Compared to the existence of the Permanence, their lives were like fleeting fyreflies.
Yet he could clearly see those twinkling lights illuminating the night sky they had traversed and would traverse together.

As Okhema falls into the blood-red twilight, the prophesied moment shall arrive.
Yet facing the inevitable strike from the black-clad swordmaster, his heart remains as calm as the vast ocean.

He believes Trailblazer will forge ahead without hesitation. By the faint glow of the Flame-Chase, he too caught a glimpse of the path he must take.
12504620661266140737:
She breaks into a violent coughing fit, struggling to keep her brush steady.
The time she has left before she can no longer move freely is limited, and in order to get the Express to start running again, she can only allocate this remaining time to the last second.
"I'm so jealous of Motoko. No need for treatments or sleep... That must free up so much time!"
The girl known as Motoko gently patted her on the head.
"Well that's exactly why you imagenated me, silly... I'll help you make your dream of reaching the stars come true."

She burned through her own time.
First was the Express, newly-restored. Its once-rusted, corroded hull had transformed into a comfortable home.
With the Starblazer's blueprint recovered, crafting a prototype was now within reach.
But the engine still lacked the fuel needed for Trailblazing, and the countdown timer for her life was already ticking down.
They turned their eyes to Phantasmoon Games. Even if the Weathering Curse could never be healed, perhaps, in that ceremony under the gaze of the gods, the Astral Express could carry them away into the cosmos.

But the bloodstained tragedy played out cycle after cycle. The Supplicant known as the Herald of Death massacred his way through Dovebrook, turning arcadia into a crimson purgatory.
One by one, the innocent fell to the devil's hands, their howls and screams carried away by the wind.
She slumped against the rubble as her life bled silently from her wounds. Her vision went blurry, and through the smoke and ash, she searched for that familiar silhouette. Motoko stood there, fire reflected in her eyes. And her reflection, too, was within those eyes.

"Do you remember the Trailblaze pledge we read?" Barely clinging to life, she reached out toward Motoko.
"Even if we don't gain the upper hand, we'll fight for right. Even when there are wheels within wheels, go ahead. Get it pulverized..."
"Isn't that a little childish... I'm not even one of the Nameless yet..."
She looked at Motoko the way one looks at a Navigator who lights up the long night.
"Himeko, you don't have to journey far to be one of the Nameless. And similarly, Trailblazing doesn't only begin with setting sail..."

Under the hopeful gazes of those around, the Wishpower of Trailblazing drew the final stroke upon the "Starblazer."
The giant of Pegana descended from the sky, smashing the frenzied killer into pieces. Beneath the glow of the Phantasmoon, the Express soared into deep space.
But this time, only a single soul made the departure.

The years that she spent studying under Yunhua were the most fulfilling and joyous of her life.

She would flitter through vials of strange herbs like a snake with a keen nose and research strange creatures from other planets. The origin of mara, the true essence of the Abominations of Abundance, medicinal pellets that eased the onset of mara... Each new research topic led her further into this fascination and caused her a lifelong obsession. Every day brought new progress and new joy.

However, in the time that she had become immersed in fragrance and fantasy, the Alchemy Commission had silently grown unstable and treacherous.
After dozens of days and nights of internal surveillance, the waves of war finally spread to immerse Cauldron Master Yunhua.
With a single order, she was stripped of her role as Cauldron Master and made a commoner.

Actually, she had smelt this strange scent coming.
The whisperings of the Preceptors, the aroma of unknown medicinal pellets around the Alchemy Commission, the nights her master had spent going to and from the Shackling Prison after receiving a mysterious message... But by the time she noticed how these things were all related, it was too late.
She sought help from her superiors in the Alchemy Commission, but her usually kind-hearted seniors had grown envious of the previous Cauldron Master and she received only cold responses and warnings.
She made an official appeal, over and over, but received the same response every time.
However, she just could not bring herself to believe that the Cauldron Master who had devoted herself wholeheartedly to the wellbeing of her patients would do anything unreasonable.

Just as she could not repress the urge to argue her master's case once more, Yunhua appeared from nowhere and gently patted her on the shoulder.
"Dan Zhu, there is no need for you to plead my innocence anymore... I am exhausted, I don't mind leaving this place."
She chased after her master, but before she could say another word, she caught a whiff of a strange scent...
The scent of a conspiratorial plot.

As the cauldron became enveloped with clouds of dark smoke, the young girl sits anxiously on the pillow, her bright eyes fixed on its rattling lid.
Following an explosion resounds through the room, the young girl runs excitedly into her master's consultation room clasping a crystal-clear pellet, despite her entire person looking scorched like a scroll left too close to a candle.
"Master Yunhua! Look, I did it!"

In the crowded consultation room, Cauldron Master Yunhua is currently treating patients.
Seeing her master focused and concentrated, the young girl obediently hides behind her master and lowers her head to sniff at the scent of the medicinal pellet.
"This pulse... it's a tough one..."
The young girl overhears her master's suspicion and approaches the patient's side to take a sniff.
"Little Dan Zhu, your sense of smell is second to none! Can you tell me anything about this patient's condition?"Yunhua calls the young girl forward and looks at her encouragingly.
"Hmm... There's a faint smell of overripe fruits, likely a sign of spleen deficiency with excessive thirst..."
"Quite right... that would match with the early symptoms. So, what medication would you recommend?"
The young girl raises the pellet in her hands and loudly proclaims: "Half of a revitalization pellet, take with water!"
...
After a long day of diagnosing and treating patients, the young girl runs after Yunhua and asks perplexedly:
"Master, why do you still insist on personally seeing patients? I see that the other high-level Alchemy Commission healers spend all their time either treating themselves or rubbing shoulders with wealthy merchants..."
Yunhua finishes organizing her medical records, kneels down, and rubs the young girl's head.
"Little Dan Zhu, have you heard something?"
"I heard people saying bad things about you..."The young girl drops her head, looking as if she's crying.
"Little Dan Zhu, what do you think is the duty of a healer?"Yunhua lets out a faint smile and picks Dan Zhu up in her arms.
"To study medicine with devotion, and to treat the sick and save the wounded..."
"If that's the case, don't you think that healers like me should spend every day working hard and being loyal to our duties?"
"...Yes, master!"
Even after seeing her master's warm smile, there is still a sliver of doubt that lingers within her heart.

He never imagined this day would come, when the Trailblaze seemed to screech to an abrupt halt.
The acrid smell of blood spread as the wrecked car spewed choking smoke and dust. He struggled to his feet, groping for direction in the darkness.
Tick-tock, tick-tock... In the deathly silence, only the echoes of life slipping away remained.

"Trailblazer..."
The deformed components in the car blocked his path. Fighting through excruciating pain, he removed the obstacles one by one. Warm blood trickled down his fingertips, but what terrified him more was that he could barely sense that familiar breathing anymore.

"Let's... go home together."
He administered the medicine he carried, the nearly depleted spirit water swirling in his palm, but against such horrific wounds, even healing was futile.
The Black Tide Creatures prowled, surrounding them both with their howls. The Cloud-Piercer shattered, crashing onto desolate rocks.
The spirit water turned crimson as he used his last ounce of strength to shield Trailblazer

He woke up from the nightmare, gasping for breath.
...

"What's up? Is there something on my face?"
At breakfast the next day, his gray-haired companion asked curiously.
"Thankfully it's not like in the dream..."
But he didn't say it out loud, just turned his gaze to the sky outside the window, "It's nothing... eat up."

The sky over Okhema remained azure blue.
But he couldn't help his thoughts from wandering, "I wonder if March is doing alright..."
The car plummeted like a burning meteor. Would she, arriving later, meet the same fate? Or perhaps something even worse...
He shook his head, pushing away the chaotic thoughts.

Another new day dawns.
With recording tools in hand, he prepares to head to the market.
The Trailblaze journey seems to be going as usual.

1824971225810259071:
The girl's world had shrunk to just herself.
The hospital's stark white sheets and curtains were like cold, impassive walls, sealing her off from the warm faces she kept in her memories.
"Don't worry, Himeko. You're smart. You'll catch up even if you miss a few days!"
"Himeko, you have to get better soon. We're still doing the model contest together!"
"Himeko... we graduated without you..."
...
Only the cold, mechanical beeping of monitors filled the room. She let her thoughts drift back to the stranded Express she had discovered, and kept sketching out those visions of setting sail.

"Cosmic Station, now arriving at Cosmic Station!"
A uniformed attendant rang the bell as a howling wind swept in from the distance. Though it was a little cold, she was still waving at the Express with barely contained exhilaration.
"Himeko! Himeko, get on board!"
A red-haired girl leaned out from the window, and a moment later, a firm hand pulled her up.
In the blink of an eye, she found herself sinking into the Express's plush red velvet seat, face to face with a girl who seemed a little older, light flickering in her eyes.
"Himeko, wanna take the wheel and head somewhere far away?" The familiar stranger asked with a smile.
Yes! The word nearly tumbled right out of her. She wanted to talk, to have friends, to find companions, to put into words the ache in her body and the hollow longing in her heart. She wanted to run, to escape, to scream...
"Come with me. Let's leave this place together." She hadn't said a word, yet somehow, the girl across from her seemed to have heard every last one of them.

The girl felt a hand take hers, and her body seemed to dissolve into a night breeze, light as a feather, as though she were flying, guided by that gentle touch.
Together, they brushed the wings of Cygnus and drifted through the heart of the Rosette Nebula. Icy comets streaked past the moon like a cascade of glittering gemstones. When the storm rolled in, the girl held her hand tight, weaving through the shattered debris of planetary rings, and when the skies grew calm again, the two of them watched the meteors of Sagittarius streak across the peaceful harbor...

"She's so brave... just like the Navigators I've read about..."
Wishes are like paint, each longing a stroke to shape the ideal into being.

At the end of Era Nova, the cold testing ground reveals its cruel core.
The tidal waves of the Remembrance merge into a tsunami, engulfing the pathstrider of Trailblaze. When he awakens, his companions are already lost in the bottomless Memory Zone.

He felt as if he'd returned to those solitary days before boarding the Express, yet the pain of this moment told him this was more than just a nightmare.
The moment he stepped back into the memoria tide, fragments of the past came rushing towards him...

"...Their heartbeat and pulse are very weak. March, get ready to perform CPR."
"Huh!? I... I don't have much experience with that. Dan Heng, you do it!"
He remembered their fateful first encounter with Trailblazer.

"I'm just imagining all the fun stuff that'll happen to us three... hehe!"
On the streets of Belobog, snow once blanketed their shoulders, and sharing a steaming hot wrap was enough to warm up the entire winter night.

"...As a descendant of the Vidyadhara, I will fulfill my duty to the Luofu."
In the presence of Trailblazer and March 7th, he broke free from the shadows of his past, as their laughter and chatter gradually melted away his snow-heavy memories.

"What did you encounter in Ena's Dream?"
"I dreamed of the Express passing station after station, with people coming and going, yet we five remained together throughout. This journey seemed as if it would never end."
In a similar Memory Zone, they had once escaped Penacony's dream together, leaving the most desired future to reality.

"Dan Heng, how much more can you sacrifice?"
The voice in his heart questioned his resolve, and he answered with decisive action.

The fading demigod entrusted the Coreflame to him. The moment he grasped it, countless gazes of desperate souls seemed to ignite his very being.
At the moment the Sacred Tree fell, he shouldered the burden of a world's creatures, fusing their bloodline with the earth of Amphoreus.

He ventured into the depths of earth's root system, searching for the direction of his companions.
Through vast jungles and endless seas, he traversed wind and frost, crossed the Dead Sea desert, and sometimes lost his way in this complex world.

In every moment when he stepped into darkness, he could always feel that gentle gaze behind him.
"We're retracing our old flight paths, with so much to redo. We need a guard... and an archiver."

"I am 'Dan Heng'..."
Along the inescapable path of the past, the wild dragon roars as it breaks free from all restraints, soaring towards the unfinished road ahead...

"I am... the one who guards the path of Trailblaze!"

With her use of burning incense, she masterfully united the ways of Luofu alchemy and the teachings of the Zhuming's Piercing Gaze, to slowly become a healer known by every soul in the Alliance.

When she received instruction to serve as Cauldron Master of the Luofu Alchemy Commission, she became a little preoccupied. However, upon arriving at the Luofu, she was disappointed to realize that not only had the Alchemy Commission not improved since she left, the internal conflict had in fact worsened.
"The first issue is that people's interests are impure and nepotism is rife. Second, there is a lack of professional dedication and constant blame passing and squabbles. Third, an unjust rewards and punishment system has put people ill at ease. Fourth, research is dismissed as worthless and patient visits neglected. Fifth, those with power take all, those dedicated to improvement become discouraged and malpractice has been rampant for considerable time..."
As she greeted others with a smile, she spent any time socializing secretly carving out an image in her heart of the problems she faced with each person.

However, the problems within the Alchemy Commission were not created overnight, nor would they be solved as quickly.
Be it the fake platitudes of the Preceptors, the constant smoke and mirrors of the Alchemy Commission healers or conflicts with other departments, her worries were endless. She would have to use huge quantities of incense in order to keep her mind steady.
"Don't get mad, don't be hasty, if I get sick then who'll replace me..."
She would smile through gritted teeth as she read through reports that made her despair and massaged her temples for comfort.

The waves still sounded outside her window.
As she watched the rising and falling of the ocean, she thought about how Yunhua must have spent her days like this back then.
"Master, continuing to practice and learn in the face of the burdens of human affairs is no simple matter..."
That young girl whose face was blackened by the exploding elixir crucible is now a grown woman, drowning in work and petty squabbles.

6637643698171922699:
The teenage girl's Trailblazing was fraught with thorns.
With the silver rail blocked, she had no choice but to feel her way through the universe, remapping the astral charts.
She had once been lost in desolate frontier worlds, venturing in and out of dangerous ruins just to scrape together dwindling supplies.
And now, once again, she was to press on alone.

She was targeted by space pirates, and in those moments of imminent peril, she did everything to shake off those desperadoes, those relics of the Energy War.
She once faced a Swarm that darkened the sky. The silver rails that she painstakingly repaired over months were destroyed in an instant.
She reached out to help a world on the brink of being devoured by a black hole, only to be mistaken for a malevolent visitor from beyond, and nearly lost her life at the edge of the black hole.
...
"Am I really the one meant to walk this path?"
At the tail end of her dreams of the Phantasmoon Games, she would often see another version of herself at the helm of the Express, soaring off into the deep reaches of space.
Yet, whenever they reunited in those dreams, that graceful and poised Navigator would always look back at her with eyes full of encouragement—
"Is the Rosette Nebula of the Celestial Comet System as beautiful as we always dreamed it would be?
"Are the silver rails you repaired forging bonds between worlds long cut off from one another?
"I know that your fearless Trailblazing saved an entire people from their destiny..."
"But I... don't know how much longer I can hold on..." She sighs wearily.
"Don't you remember? 'Nameless' was never just one person's name. Just as the flame of the Trailblaze set you ablaze, so will it set others ablaze too."

Outside the window, the wings of Cygnus shimmered, and icy comets streaked past the moon like a cascade of glittering gemstones.
She steered the Express through the shattered debris of planetary rings, and when she finally reached the peaceful harbor, the meteors of Sagittarius happened to cascade down.
Welt and his golden-haired companion stepped aboard the Express.
When the Express fell into peril, the taciturn Dan Heng took down the beast with a single strike. In that moment, she saw the fire inside him, and offered him the navigator's invitation.
She rescued March 7th, adrift in the cosmos, and from that day on, the trailblazing expedition took on the hue of March's vibrant color.
Guided by destiny, she crossed paths with Trailblazer at the space station. Somehow, the feeling that this brave, free-spirited child would bring endless surprises in the future never left her.

Jarilo-VI, the Xianzhou Luofu, Penacony, Amphoreus... More and more people walk alongside the "Trailblaze," and she has found companions truly worthy of being called "family," and her name has been engraved across countless worlds.
By all accounts, this was a miracle, and one that she hoped wholeheartedly would never end.
6780183298317476878:
She quickly came to realize that perhaps leaving would be her best option.
With the help of the Preceptors, they left the Luofu together and headed for the Zhuming. The past flashed before her eyes. As they were immersed in a world of medicine and research, they were blithely unaware that a huge net woven by the hearts of men had already ensnared them.

"If you never learn how to face this world, your ideals will face only inevitable destruction."
She vowed to herself never to let something like this happen again.
Thanks to Yunhua's introduction, she was able to meet with the Zhuming High Elder Ardens Regia, and enter the Piercing Gaze sect to study specialist medical treatments such as acupuncture, aromatherapy, and pyropathy.
She fixed her previous pattern of turning a blind eye to the world around her and came to work alongside people of all walks of life harmoniously.

As time passed, she realized that every type of person, every type of "illness" had their own unique scent.
She had smelled the putrid stench of envy.
While she studied at the Zhuming, she did not allow the mysterious disappearance of medicinal herbs and the subsequent misunderstandings and cold shoulders to crush her. She dispelled all doubts and mocking with incense that no seasoned alchemist could ever hope to match.
She had smelled the fetid stench of conspiracy, hypocrisy.
When working with biotechnology experts from other planets, she traced the thin veil of clues that revealed their schemes and thwarted their secret intentions to collude with the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus.
She had smelled the foul stench of covetous greed.
When she served as a Zhuming military healer, she came to understand the huge benefits of medicines hidden in the barracks and investigated in secret to expose corrupt members in one fell swoop.

The "afflictions" of humanity had nowhere to hide under her diagnosis, she was always able to formulate the perfect "incense" to dispel their scent.
"If I am unable to stand head and shoulders above my peers like my master, then I shall dedicate myself to learning the hearts of man and fighting them fair and square."
She changed her name to "Lingsha."
Her medicinal namesake's fluctuation of yin and yang, its properties of both water and fire make it a miracle cure to those in mortal danger, just as she herself wished to become.

He felt as if he was back on the speeding Astral Express.
He watched as the Express ventured into the vast unknown, blazing trails never traveled before.

In the endlessly stretching path through space, he saw a giant dragon soaring through chaos.
It once slumbered in its egg, until one day it emerged in rebirth.
It met others of its kind, sharing the same bloodline and path.
It stirred vast spirit waters, bringing rain and nourishing all living things.
It upheld the earth of gold and stone, protecting the eternal prosperity of all nations...
Its path still winds toward the future.
War's flames licked its scales, and from that heat, it shed its old scales time and time again, gaining rebirth.
Then, together with the Express, it leaped toward the future.

...

"You know, in the future, if the Express gets covered in a layer of cosmic barnacles that won't wash off, Dan Heng can use his... Dragonquake Boom to sand them away!"
"Great idea. Look, Dan Heng's waking up... Want to bet whether it was a good dream or..."

"You guys are too noisy..."
As soon as he opened his eyes, he saw Trailblazer and March whispering loudly next to his ear.
"Come on, spill it! Falling asleep at a time like this. What sweet dreams were you having?"

March stretched lazily, gazing into the distance with anticipation.
"Let me guess, did you dream about what's going to happen on our upcoming journey?"
"..."
"Do you even need to ask? Of course we're gonna beat up all the bad guys!"

The wind that blew then seemed to carry the aroma of breakfast from the Express.
"Let's... go home together."
 He made a silent vow, as he had in the past, and would in the future.
